task: Find a used SUV under $25k within 25 miles
notes: CarGurus: 2,939 results. Autotrader: 1,690. Both are quick to set up, but CarGurus's layout jumps when the first filter is applied.

task: Filter by must-have features (AWD + Apple CarPlay)
notes: CarGurus: 518 left. Autotrader: 574 left. CarPlay and AWD sit in two different sections on both sites, and neither says which filters are worth using next.

task: Compare 3 shortlisted cars side by side
notes: CarGurus compares straight from the results page, but only 2 cars at a time. On Autotrader no compare control turned up on the results or listing pages.

task: Judge whether a listing's price is fair
notes: CarGurus: deal rating, dollars below market, price history and days on market. Autotrader: price rating and dollars below expected price, no price history seen.

task: Check a car's history and condition
notes: CarGurus shows title, accidents and owners near the top; the full report is paid. Autotrader shows accidents and owners far down the page.

task: Contact the dealer about a listing
notes: Both put a contact button and phone number at the top of the listing. Nothing was submitted.
